account: Superpower Glass, developed at Stanford University, runs a machine-learning facial-expression classifier on Google Glass. It shows a child which emotion a facing person is displaying. An at-home feasibility study had intake between July and October 2016 (day not given, so 1 July is used). In it, 14 children with autism completed the protocol. The feasibility paper reports a 7.14-point SRS-2 reduction in its abstract and from its published means, but its results prose gives 7.38 points. Twelve of 14 families reported more eye contact (npj Digital Medicine, 2018). A randomized trial enrolled 71 children aged 6 to 12 from 1 November 2016 to 11 April 2018. Those adding the device to applied behavioral analysis therapy gained 4.58 points more on the Vineland socialization subscale than controls (P = .005). Three other primary measures did not reach significance (JAMA Pediatrics, 2019). Results are cohort-level.

ai_role.statement: The emotion classifier, trained on public facial-expression databases and tuned for home conditions, generates the real-time cues the intervention relies on. The Guess the Emotion game within the package does not use the classifier. So part of the effect may come from structured family interaction rather than the AI.

fields.account: Superpower Glass, developed at Stanford University, runs a machine-learning facial-expression classifier on Google Glass. It shows a child which emotion a facing person is displaying. An at-home feasibility study had intake between July and October 2016 (day not given, so 1 July is used). In it, 14 children with autism completed the protocol. The feasibility paper reports a 7.14-point SRS-2 reduction in its abstract and from its published means, but its results prose gives 7.38 points. Twelve of 14 families reported more eye contact (npj Digital Medicine, 2018). A randomized trial enrolled 71 children aged 6 to 12 from 1 November 2016 to 11 April 2018. Those adding the device to applied behavioral analysis therapy gained 4.58 points more on the Vineland socialization subscale than controls (P = .005). Three other primary measures did not reach significance (JAMA Pediatrics, 2019). Results are cohort-level.
